records.summary: Malaysia and Vietnam on 6 May 2009 lodged a joint submission to the UN Commission on the Limits of the Continental Shelf claiming continental shelf beyond 200 nautical miles in a defined area of the southern South China Sea, informing the Commission that there were unresolved disputes in the area.
records.presort: new move (novelty) — Joint Malaysia-Vietnam submission to the CLCS of shelf beyond 200 nm is a new method of advancing the claim before an international authority; 2008 shows only the preparatory trust fund (ev-4a76c6e88e). Declarative lead. (group MY2009-CLCS) [claude-code/opus]
